notes.title: 1.28.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
We've added some new items to make building levels even more fun!

Elemental Snowmen and Skeletons are immune to elements based on their type. We've also added speed settings to all enemies so you can decide how fast or slow they move.

Elemental mushrooms can freeze, burn, poison, or charm whatever destroys them. These are a great way to create one-off elemental effects in your levels.

Engines now have material variants for even more possibilities.

Happy Hopping!

You'll also notice Goats and Snowmen have had their art improved, we hope you like the new look!

 Linked platforms getting separated sometimes
 Crown power not taking effect before first move

Happy Hopping!

notes.title: Welcome to round 11 of our community level contest!
notes.content:
Prizes:
1st: 2,000 💎 
2nd: 1,000 💎 
3rd: 500 💎  

Two free rabbits will also be given out: Royal Ruby #11 (donated by CleanShirt) for the best use of the Extra Credit assignment as chosen by contest mods and Sky #55 (donated by xove) as a random drawing for anyone who submits a level. 

This round, the theme is Some Bunny Loves You. Have you ever fallen for someone who just wasn’t interested in you? Maybe they even actively disliked you? Wouldn’t it be great if you could give them a magic love potion? Your challenge this round is to make a partner level using a goat that dislikes you (no charmed goat). You and the goat should be separated by water, and the goat must be used to finish the level. For a Valentine’s Day twist, the goat must “fall in love” with you (become charmed) by the end, and you must both exit the level.

Extra Credit: Use the decor in your level to create a candy heart message (BE MINE, IGOTU BABE, XOXO, etc.) We want the words - it doesn’t have to be heart shaped. Most clever, creative, and related will win!

- All piece types are allowed.
- The entire build area is allowed
- All themes are allowed.
- One uncharmed goat must be included.
- Level must include “R11” in title.
- Only Verified Discord users may enter

JOIN FOR FREE!

notes.title: New music, localizations, filters, settings, notifications #21

After years of re-building King Rabbit we are finally nearing the big release on iOS and Android. In a way, this is only the beginning as we plan to continue updating King Rabbit for many years. 

It has been a long journey and a lot of effort from both of us to get to this point. We thank everyone who has been a part of our journey and offered words of encouragement, positive reviews, and financial support via in-game purchases. 

After years of living very frugally in order to create this game, we are optimistic the mobile release will provide us with a foundation to grow the business. If things go well with this mobile release, we will be financially able to hire our first employees and invest more to improve the King Rabbit service. 

We invite you to pre-order on iOS (free). 

Thank you!

notes.title: Kingdom and Realms update! #16
notes.content:
To make the campaign more engaging, we’ve created the “Kingdom” and “Realms” that you can explore. We hope you enjoy this new campaign structure! :)

KINGDOM

The kingdom is the central location or “home” that ties the game together. Within the Kingdom there are different realms that you can access.

REALMS

Each realm contains three portals. Each portal contains 10 levels, the last level has a portal gem. To complete the realm, you must find the portal gem! For the completionist types, if you find all of the gold in a portal - there will be a gold border surrounding the portal gem. 

Currently we offer two realms; Garden and Community. Over time we will continue to add new realms for you to explore.

NEW LEVEL FILTERS

Portals for "best", "puzzle", and "Action" can now be found in the community realm. Best levels are determined by community feedback and an algorithm.

EXPANSIONS REFUNDED

Previously, we were selling packs of the “best” levels for gems under the name "pink diamond expansion". Anyone who purchased the expansion has been refunded. We will no longer be selling packs, but instead giving away for free! 

Let us know what you think in the comments! <3

OTHER STUFF

* Snowmen charge 2 tiles now
* Art updated for several items
* Ice crown now allows rabbit to walk on ice without slipping
* Fire and element pit particles updated
* Items float higher making them easier to see behind walls
* Themed walls are back

notes.title: Underworld theme, goats, elemental pits! #6
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/7af5f873e4a1b0e24865b2243590e20e36197063.gif

King Rabbit just got a little better, this is a pretty big update. <3

UNDERWORLD THEME!

You can now build using the underworld theme! Just click the theme icon within the level builder. The underworld has some differences in mechanics; metal objects float in lava while wooden objects burn up on contact. If you change your level’s theme you’ll have to revalidate it. 

GOATS!

Goats have replaced the reaper character. They behave similarly, following you around and trying to swing their weapon at you. We felt that the goat was more consistent with the King Rabbit universe. Four elemental goats have been added. Elemental goats have immunities to an element just like the rabbit when wielding a crown.

COMPLETION REWARDS

Now you get a small reward for completing level packs. If you’ve already beaten the level packs you can go and claim your gifts now! Your campaign progress is now visible when you complete a level. Possible rewards include gold and hints, more reward types to be added at a later time.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/18a9ede31140de792dd88246a25da4e1997c693d.gif

ELEMENT PITS

These are basically “fire pits” that come in 4 different elements; fire, ice, poison, and charm. Any projectiles passing over the element pit will be immediately converted to the element of that pit.

FREE LEVELS!

We've added 60 new levels for your enjoyment! Prepare yourself for a challenge, some of them are difficult but not impossible. You'll find the levels in the play tab.

DIAMOND ECONOMY

Diamonds are the premium currency used to buy premium content, but unlike other games - you can earn premium currency via tips from other players. This of course requires some players (maybe you?) to invest in the community and support their favorite builders. If you can spare a few dollars, show the community some love by tipping with diamonds. We're still in early access and there aren't a ton of active players, manage your expectations on getting rich. ;)

OTHER STUFF

* Fixed OSX Steam launching error (re-install King Rabbit if you still see it)
* Fixed frozen bomb going transparent when unfrozen
* Texture added to wooden wall sprites
* TNT crates can now be put inside of locked crates
* Level grid size reduced to 15 x 15
* You can now see how much gold you've earned in community levels

notes.title: Rabbit hole item added, windowed mode! #4
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/7d9ca86e6e58a5096702f600bf2e961fa54363da.gif

ABOUT RABBIT HOLES

 Link two rabbit holes together to create a portal!
 The direction you enter the rabbit hole determines the direction you exit the rabbit hole! 
 You can push items and frozen or charmed enemies into rabbit holes
 Rabbit holes can be linked together to create crazy loops


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/d0c9ff1a6cb92b2ac5caec584a465ad5385d0a79.gif

OTHER THINGS

 Windowed mode added
 Wooden wall art updated
 Updated "containment" particle, it's easier to see when something has something inside
 Fixed inconsistent item dropping behavior
 Fixed bug with pistons pushing two crates into each other into a river

WHAT'S NEXT?

We will be focusing on the campaign experience for the next update. This will make the experience more enjoyable for everyone. This means the rabbit skins update will be pushed back!

Thanks and happy hopping!
RareSloth

Edit: We are aware of a bug that allows you to place the rabbit hole directly under the rabbit, this will be fixed soon.

notes.title: King Rabbit first release! #1
notes.content:
Welcome players,

You're an early adopter, and we really appreciate you! Thank you for being here. We will continue to update King Rabbit regularly. The best way for you to provide feedback is to post in our Discord!

Up next is a level builder update! This will include:

 Better statistics for the levels you build
 Replays of players playing your levels
 Builder polish and improvements

King Rabbit is far from perfect but our long term goal is to make this one of the best puzzle experiences in the world. Thank you for your patience, support, and feedback.
